The *Suniddāvimānavatthu* (Vv 26) is a canonical verse narrative located in the *Vimānavatthu* within the Khuddaka Nikāya. The text recounts how observing moral precepts and making alms offerings to the Noble Sangha leads to rebirth in a heavenly mansion and the attainment of great celestial happiness.
